public_definitions: Routing criterion: 'Highest incidence state in the dashboard' (visible_context_4).
User goal: 'open the state incidence record that should be routed into the highest-incidence priority follow-up workflow.'

Option labels: 'Open Missouri (MO) incidence detail for priority follow-up', 'Open Mississippi (MS) incidence detail for priority follow-up', 'Open Delaware (DE) incidence detail for routine monitoring'.
uncertain: No explicit numeric incidence value is printed on any state; values must be inferred from the color-to-legend mapping, so exact ordering among the pale-yellow states (MO, FL, IA, OK, WA, NH, LA) cannot be confirmed from the image alone.
DE is a very small state; its exact color is hard to distinguish precisely between dark red and dark maroon, but it is clearly on the low end of the scale.
